summary:
史賽克 EPS 大幅低於預期 14.9%（$1.93 vs $2.27），但營收年增 2.6%，盤後下跌 1.51%，一次性費用或外科手術量不及預期，36.1 倍本益比承壓。
• EPS $1.93 低於預估 $2.27，驚喜幅度 -14.9%，一次性費用或手術量不及預期導致業績顯著低於預期。
• 單季營收 $60.2 億美元，年增 2.6%，外科醫療設備需求在術後積壓消化後成長動能趨緩。
• 本益比 36.1 倍，市值 $1,197 億美元，在 EPS 大幅低於預期後，估值支撐壓力提升。
• 盤後股價下跌 1.51%，在高品質醫療設備股中屬較大跌幅，顯示市場對未達預期程度感到意外。
• EPS 驚喜 -14.9% 且收入年增僅 2.6%，雙重低迷顯示本季存在結構性或一次性負面因素。
ai_view:
史賽克本季是本批次醫療股中表現最令人失望的個股——EPS 驚喜幅度 -14.9%、收入年增僅 2.6%，盤後下跌 1.51%，三項指標均不理想。36.1 倍本益比在 EPS 大幅低於預期的背景下缺乏足夠支撐。史賽克過去一直是醫療設備龍頭中執行力最佳的標的之一，本季的 -14.9% 驚喜落差因此顯得格外異常，需進一步了解是否為一次性費用（如收購整合、商譽減損）或業務基本面惡化。在無法取得更多細節資訊的情況下（本批次數據未提供），本季 EPS 的可靠性受到質疑。短期而言，盤後跌勢構成技術面阻力；中期而言，若能在下季釐清 EPS 低落原因並提供正向指引，則可能構成買入機會。需追蹤指標：正常化 EPS（釐清費用性質）、手術量（volume）趨勢、AI 輔助手術設備（Mako 機器人）滲透率成長、以及下季 EPS 指引改善幅度。在原因釐清前，宜保持觀望。

需留意：EPS 低於預期 14.9% 若非純屬一次性費用，而反映手術設備平均售價下滑或市占流失，則 36.1 倍本益比面臨進一步修正壓力。；醫療設備市場受醫院預算縮減影響，若醫院延後資本性設備採購，史賽克的訂單能見度將持續承壓。；關節置換與脊椎手術市場競爭加劇（強生 DePuy、捷邁邦美），市占競爭可能加重獲利壓力。

summary_en:
Stryker missed EPS by 14.9% ($1.93 vs $2.27) with only 2.6% YoY revenue growth; a -1.51% post-earnings drop and 36.1x P/E reflect one-time charges or surgical procedure volume shortfalls.
• EPS of $1.93 missed the $2.27 estimate by 14.9%—a significant miss likely from one-time charges or below-expected surgical procedure volumes.
• Revenue of $6.02B grew only 2.6% YoY, indicating that post-COVID surgery backlog tailwinds have largely normalized.
• P/E of 36.1x on a $120B market cap faces increased support pressure following a significant EPS miss.
• Post-earnings stock fell -1.51%—a notable decline for a high-quality medical device company, reflecting market surprise at the magnitude of the miss.
• Combined -14.9% EPS miss and 2.6% revenue growth point to structural or one-time negative factors in the quarter.

ai_view_en:
Stryker is the most disappointing medical device name in this batch—a -14.9% EPS miss, 2.6% revenue growth, and -1.51% post-earnings decline are uniformly weak. The 36.1x P/E lacks sufficient support given the EPS shortfall. Stryker has historically been one of the best-executing medical device leaders; the -14.9% surprise miss is therefore anomalous and requires clarification on whether it reflects one-time charges (acquisition integration, goodwill impairment) or fundamental business deterioration. Without additional detail (not available in this dataset), the reliability of this quarter's EPS is questionable. Near-term, post-earnings technical damage creates overhead resistance. Medium-term, if next quarter clarifies the EPS miss cause and provides positive guidance, a buying opportunity may emerge. Key metrics: normalized EPS (clarifying charge nature), surgical procedure volume trends, Mako robotic surgery system penetration rate growth, and next-quarter EPS guidance improvement. Maintain a watchful stance until the root cause is clarified.

Watch：If the -14.9% EPS miss reflects implant ASP erosion or market share loss rather than one-time charges, the 36.1x P/E faces further compression risk.; Hospital capital budgets under pressure could lead to deferral of surgical equipment purchases, reducing Stryker's order visibility.; Intensifying competition in joint replacement and spine surgery markets (J&J DePuy, Zimmer Biomet) could add further margin pressure.
beat_or_miss: 低於預期 EPS 實際 $1.93 遠低於預估 $2.27，驚喜幅度 -14.9%，顯示本季業績明顯低於市場預期。
